title: Civilizations switching on at the same time around 3000 BC

tellings.quote: that's exactly the same period that the engine of the Indus Valley civilization was switched on in what is now Pakistan

plain: A writer on lost ancient civilizations, Graham Hancock, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that around 3000 to 2500 BC great civilizations seem to switch on at once: in Egypt, in the Indus Valley in what is now Pakistan, and along the Yellow River in China. He takes the timing as a sign that they may share an older, forgotten source.
